'''2011 US Nationals Peter Jacobson DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Peter Jacobson (Jeeps)
* '''Deck name:''' Quesosauce's Sandy V!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
